summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the 2026 annual grant of performance-related restricted shares under its Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP). The CEO received 799,835 restricted shares valued at £10.861 per share, representing 850% of salary. The award vests on 1 May 2029 subject to performance conditions, with a two-year holding period thereafter. This is a routine executive equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. The filing is a UK Market Abuse Regulation notification and does not involve a business combination, activist campaign, or structural change.
